cohort: Patients undergoing labor induction after fetal demise (intrauterine fetal death or termination of pregnancy with feticide) between 28 to 40 weeks of gestation with an unfavorable cervix.
finding: PGE1 regimen resulted in a shorter induction-to-delivery time interval and duration of labor but was associated with greater pain during induction, while PGE2 required more oxytocin augmentation.
